name: Wishlist
description: Favourites: a heart on every product, a list the customer can filter, buy from and share — kept for guests as a basket is and merged into the account on signing in.

settings.label: A heart on catalogue cards
settings.help: On the product page and in the search window it is always there.

settings.label: A notice in the corner when a product is added
settings.help: The photograph, the name and a link to the list, just under the header; it leaves by itself after a few seconds and stays while the pointer is over it.

settings.label: Customers may share their list by a link
settings.help: Whoever has the link sees the products and can buy them — never whose list it is. The owner can replace the link or close it.

settings.label: Offer letters about price drops and returns
settings.help: Two switches on the list page, for customers with an account; both are off until the customer turns them on. Off here, nothing is offered and nothing is sent.

settings.label: A price drop worth a letter, %
settings.help: Measured against the price when the product was saved, or when the last letter about it went. Checked every morning and after an exchange rate changes.

settings.label: Keep a guest's list for, days
settings.help: A list nobody has touched and nobody signed in with is deleted after this. An account's list is kept for ever. 0 keeps guests' lists for ever too.
